checks.result: Three bosses × three attempts per Bangkok day; each attempt is spent at start with no refund on retreat, the boss enters with the HP left from earlier attempts, the party starts full, the limit is 60 s and the 4th start returns DAILY_NO_ATTEMPTS.

One timed attempt that empties several bars gives one chest per bar (claim keys boss+day+phase); each next bar is stronger, the clock is not reset and the result is not a victory; server settlement equals the runner with the shared mode policy.
An attempt started 23:59:45 Bangkok and finished after midnight writes only its ticket day; old-day chests stay claimable and the new day starts with phase 1 and 0 rewarded bars.

A second start is BATTLE_ALREADY_ACTIVE; advance/retreat after settlement are ACTIVE_BATTLE_MISMATCH with records/chests unchanged; there is no HP/phase rollback, and the client SavedBattleSession confirms every server checkpoint. Live: a treasury attempt through the real API/DB reserved 1 attempt and kept phase/HP/chest.
